reading.title: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age
reading.summary: New rules introduced on Tuesday mean establishments will be able to accept digital ID apps alongside physical documents.

news.title: Iranian actor Laleh Marzban faces severe threats after Venice film festival speech
news.summary: Marzban, who won a best actress award for her portrayal of a woman held hostage by her father in Falling House, has received condemnations from authorities after dedicating her prize to ‘the women of Iran’ An Iranian actress who won the best newcomer award at the Venice film festival has come under severe attack from the country’s authorities and state media after highlighting the plight of women in Iran in her acceptance speech. Laleh Marzban last Saturday won the best actress award in the Orizzonti sidebar competition for emerging talent, for her role in Mohsen Gharaei’s Falling House , a film revolving around three generations of women who are incarcerated in their own home by the family’s father.
